status: Proposal only; not instantiated in a game engine
coordinate_frame: Blender Z-up metres, same design waterline datum as visual

body_proposal.construction: For each 15 degree hull sector, create a convex hull from that sector only; do not merge sectors across the seating well
body_proposal.preserve_void: Keep open XY well above the recessed membrane; no global convex hull

seat_proposal.construction: Use underside/top membrane triangles or narrow local strips, excluding central drain; never an AABB that fills from membrane to rim height

sampled_surface.mesh_type: Reduced open-centre top surface; build local patches or an engine-supported concave surface, never a global convex volume
sampled_surface.winding: Counterclockwise from above; all sampled top triangle normals have positive local Z

grip_proposal.type: capsule chains along the two grip paths
grip_proposal.preserve_void: Keep openings under arches; no grip AABB or one convex body filling finger space

excluded: Tiny seams, flexible appliques and valve can be omitted from broadphase collision; proposed contact records retained separately
limitations: Collision choice depends on recovered engine dynamic-body support. No solver, buoyancy or physical handling check.
